box.highlights: Dylan Craig rushed 21 times for 145 yards and two touchdowns, made five PATs and had an interception and a fumble recovery to lead Bayport-Blue Point to a 35-0 win over Miller Place in a Suffolk IV opener.

Bayport-Blue Point 34, Center Moriches 7: Cooper Fuller completed 4 of 6 passes for 105 yards and two touchdowns and added 12 carries for 72 yards and a TD to lead Bayport-Blue Point (2-0) in Suffolk IV. Dylan Craig caught a 65-yard TD pass and ran for a 6-yard score. Sean Coffey added a 12-yard TD run and Colin Most caught a TD pass. Brayden Hromada ran for a 9-yard TD for Center Moriches (1-1).
Cooper Fuller accounted for five touchdowns in visiting Bayport-Blue Point's 41-7 win over Shoreham-Wading River in Suffolk IV.

Bayport-Blue Point 27, Glenn 7: Sean Coffey rushed for 76 yards on four carries and two touchdowns to lead Bayport-Blue Point (4-0) in Suffolk IV. Dylan Craig added a one-yard run and Cooper Fuller added a 49-yard run. KaRahn King scored a four-yard run for Glenn (1-3).

Bayport-Blue Point 42, Wyandanch 6: Sean Coffey rushed for 100 yards on five carries, including 30 and 19-yard touchdown runs for Bayport-Blue Point (5-0) in Suffolk IV. He also had a 63-yard touchdown reception from Cooper Fuller. Frank Josh rushed for 42 yards and a touchdown, and Dylan Crag had an 8-yard touchdown run. Craig also went 6 for 6 on PATs. Elijah Duncan had an 87-yard kick return for a touchdown for Wyandanch (0-5).

Bayport-Blue Point 12, Babylon 7: Cooper Fuller rushed for the game-winning touchdown in the fourth-quarter to lead Bayport-Blue Point (6-0) in Suffolk IV. After Fuller's touchdown, Traigh Tommasone recorded a crucial interception and allowed the offense to run the clock out and lock down the victory. Fuller rushed 24 times for 180 yards, while Colin Reyer chipped in four carries for 65 yards. In the second quarter, Christian Saur recorded a strip-sack in the second quarter and Dylan Spano recovered the loose ball in the end zone for a touchdown to tie the game. Kai Jankow rushed for Babylon's (5-1) only touchdown from 39 yards out.

Bayport-Blue Point 46, Port Jefferson 7: Hank Bosse ran 14 times for 101 yards and a touchdown while Sean Coffey rushed three times for 64 yards and two touchdowns to lead Bayport-Blue Point (7-0) in Suffolk IV. Dylan Craig added six carries for 80 yards and a touchdown while Colin Clark ran four times for 84 yards. Cooper Fuller rushed twice for seven yards and scored on both carries. Colin Reyer added a 25-yard run on his only touch. On defense, Colin Most and Rodney Magee each picked off a pass. For Port Jefferson (1-6), Chris Diot threw a 30-yard touchdown pass to Keegan Henry and Tomas Qepuri made the extra point.
Bayport-Blue Point defeated Mount Sinai, 41-10, in a Suffolk Division IV regular-season finale. It was BBP's 31st win in a row.

Bayport-Blue Point 42, Greenport 14: Cooper Fuller completed 4 of 4 passes for 54 yards and rushed for 120 yards and two touchdowns on seven carries to lead host No. 1 Bayport-Blue Point over No. 8 Greenport in the Suffolk Division IV quarterfinals. Colin Reyer rushed for 50 yards and two touchdowns on three carries. Hank Bosse and Shane Dunne each added touchdown runs. Michael DeNicola found Ethan Linker for two touchdowns for Greenport (4-5). Bayport-Blue Point (9-0) will host a semifinal game.

Bayport-Blue Point 28, Glenn 7: Cooper Fuller had 25 carries for 236 yards and three touchdowns to lead host No. 1 Bayport-Blue Point over No. 4 Glenn in the Suffolk Division IV semifinals. Fuller also had an interception and threw for 32 yards and a touchdown. Colin Most had a 27-yard touchdown catch. Aiden Richman had an interception. Patrick Ahern and Dylan Spano each had a sack. Dylan Craig went 4 of 4 on extra-point attempts. Bayport-Blue Point (10-0) will face No. 3 Miller Place in the Suffolk IV championship at 6 p.m. Thursday at Stony Brook's LaValle Stadium. Cole Madden threw a 77-yard touchdown pass to Joe Competiello for Glenn, which finished 5-5.
Bayport-Blue Point defeated Miller Place to secure its third straight Suffolk Division IV title.

Wantagh 29, Bayport-Blue Point 21
Dylan Martini rushed for 142 yards on 25 carries and threw a half-back option pass for an 18 yard touchdown as Wantagh defeated Bayport-Blue Point in the Long Island Class IV championship. Ryan Conigliaro completed 13 of 16 passes for 168 yards and three touchdowns for Wantagh. Both teams finished the season with 11-1 records. BBP was the two-time defending LIC Class IV champion and saw its 34 game winning streak end. This is Wantagh's first LIC title since it won the Class III crown in 2016.
